privacyIntro: Information about the processing of personal data under Articles 12, 13, 14 and 21 of the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).
controllerNotice: The administrator or operator of this server instance is the data controller within the meaning of the GDPR.
dataHeading: 2. Types of data collected and purposes of processing
accountNotice: Registration stores your username, email address and a cryptographic password hash. Your email address is used for account activation, password recovery and security notifications. The accepted terms version and acceptance timestamp are also stored.
aquariumNotice: The data you enter (aquarium names, dimensions, water parameters, care activities, stocking lists and uploaded images) is stored in the database to provide recording and analysis features.
storageLabel: Session cookies & local storage (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR / § 25(2) TDDDG):
cookieIntro: A technically essential, encrypted session cookie (
cookieNotice: , HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax) is used for user authentication. Display preferences (such as dark mode or filter settings) are stored locally in your browser (localStorage). No advertising or tracking cookies are used.
emailNotice: System notifications (verification links, password resets, sharing invitations and configured measurement/fertilization reminders) are sent by email through the configured SMTP server.
aiLabel: AI chat assistant & language models (Art. 6(1)(a) & (b) GDPR):
aiNotice: Using the AI aquarium assistant is entirely optional (“Bring Your Own Key”). If you add a personal API key for OpenAI (ChatGPT), Google Gemini or Anthropic Claude in your profile and submit a chat request, the aquarium details (name, volume, dimensions, equipment and substrate), stocking (plant and animal species) and up to the last 10 measurements are sent to the selected provider as context to generate relevant answers. API keys are stored securely in the database, displayed only in masked form in the frontend and can be completely deleted from your profile at any time.
logsNotice: When you access the application, technical server logs (IP address, timestamp, HTTP status and error messages) are recorded to ensure its functionality, availability and security.
localHeading: 3. Local processing, no external trackers & external services
localNotice: This application supports self-hosting and does not use advertising trackers. Libraries and fonts are loaded locally. Public Social content is accessible worldwide. Hosting, email, authentication and optionally enabled AI providers may process data for the features used; the operator must identify the providers actually used and any applicable international transfers.
providerPrivacyNotice: If you choose to use the AI chat feature, communication takes place through the official API of your selected provider. Further information about data processing is available in the providers’ privacy policies:
retentionHeading: 4. Retention and complete data deletion (right to be forgotten)
retentionNotice: Active account data is generally stored for the lifetime of the account. Social content and backups also follow the retention and deletion rules described above. The operator must separately identify any legally required retention.
deletionIntro: You can permanently delete your account yourself at any time in your profile (
deletionNotice: ) using the account deletion feature. After confirmation by email, associated active data and uploaded images are removed. The rules above for local and external backups also apply; copies of public content already made by third parties cannot be recalled.
rightsHeading: 5. Your rights as a data subject
rightsIntro: Under the GDPR, you have the following rights against the data controller:
accessNotice: You may request information about your stored data at any time.
rectificationNotice: You can correct inaccurate data in your profile or in the respective aquariums.
erasureNotice: You may request the complete deletion of your data.
portabilityNotice: You can download your measurements at any time in a commonly used, machine-readable format using the integrated CSV/Excel export feature.
restrictionLabel: Restriction of processing (Art. 18 GDPR) & objection (Art. 21 GDPR):
restrictionNotice: You may object to data processing within the scope of applicable law.
complaintLabel: Right to lodge a complaint (Art. 77 GDPR):
complaintNotice: You have the right to lodge a complaint with a competent data protection supervisory authority.
